scientific.integrity: The motivating full PDF was inspected at the delayed model, the definition a=a0 exp(-mu0 tau), Theorem 2.2, the equilibrium cubic, and Figures 1–2; the theorem page and figure page were visually inspected. Earlier and later sterile-mosquito threshold literature was compared for implication coverage. Exact symbolic and high-precision replay verifies the source-specific formulas and numerical correction. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns equilibrium existence for the constant continuous-release model. It does not analyze the proportional-release model, periodic releases, residual fertility, or sex-structured variants.

title: Maturation delay strictly lowers the constant sterile-release threshold
